description: This file defines the class PackagerImplementation which implements the IPackager interface for managing software packages, including configuration, installation, synchronization, and related data structures and methods within the WPEFramework plugin.

classes.name: PackagerImplementation
classes.description: Main class implementing the IPackager interface, managing package operations, configuration, notifications, and internal data structures.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: JSON configuration container for package settings such as temp directory, cache directory, verbosity, and signature checks.

classes.name: PluginConfig
classes.description: JSON configuration container for plugin-specific settings like system root path.

classes.name: PackageInfo
classes.description: Represents package metadata including name, version, and architecture.

classes.name: InstallInfo
classes.description: Represents installation status, progress, error codes, and application name.

classes.name: InstallationData
classes.description: Holds pointers to current package and installation info during operations.

classes.name: InstallThread
classes.description: Worker thread class for handling package installation asynchronously.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification observer for package events.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the package manager with the provided service.

methods.name: Install
methods.description: Initiates installation of a package with specified name, version, and architecture.

methods.name: DoWork
methods.description: Performs package-related work based on provided package details.

methods.name: GetMetadataFile
methods.description: Retrieves metadata file path for a given application name.

methods.name: GetCallsign
methods.description: Generates or retrieves the callsign for a given filename.

methods.name: GetInstallationPath
methods.description: Determines installation path for a given application name.

methods.name: DeactivatePlugin
methods.description: Deactivates a plugin based on callsign and application name.

methods.name: UpdateConfiguration
methods.description: Updates configuration for a specific callsign and application.

methods.name: NotifyStateChange
methods.description: Notifies observers of a state change.

methods.name: NotifyRepoSynced
methods.description: Notifies observers that repository sync has completed.

methods.name: BlockingSetupLocalRepoNoLock
methods.description: Sets up local repository in a blocking manner.
